project.title: Comparison of the salivary proteome of rats after a fermented diet
project.projectDescription: This study shows that the consumption of cheese modulates the diversity of the oral microbiota. The persistence of exogenous bacteria in the oral cavity appears to be linked to thesalivary  proteome composition, which are influenced by oxidative stress. The origin of this oxidative stress has not been determined.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Eighteen saliva samples collected in the cheese-diet group during the pre-diet period wereprepared for the LC-MS/MS.The saliva samples prepared for the analyses come from the saliva of rats presenting cheese bacteria persistence and saliva from rats without bacterial persistence.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Quantification of proteins by label free (progenesisQI) and identification by MASCOT and PEAKS.
